name: Vasubandhu's five gates of practice and five gates of merit

stages.name: worship (lìbài mén)
stages.gloss: bodily worship of Amitābha
stages.description: Bowing to Amitābha intending birth.

stages.name: praise (zàntàn mén)
stages.gloss: calling the name
stages.description: Calling the name in accord with the light and meaning of the name.

stages.name: aspiration (zuòyuàn mén)
stages.gloss: śamatha
stages.description: Single-minded aspiration for birth = practising śamatha.

stages.name: contemplation (guānchá mén)
stages.gloss: vipaśyanā of the 29 adornments
stages.description: Contemplating the land, the Buddha and the bodhisattvas with right mindfulness.

stages.name: transfer (huíxiàng mén)
stages.gloss: dedication with great compassion
stages.description: Not abandoning suffering beings, making transfer foremost.

stages.name: gate of approach (jìn mén)
stages.gloss: born in the Land of Peace and Bliss
stages.description: Fruit of worship.

stages.name: gate of the great assembly (dàhuìzhòng mén)
stages.gloss: entering the number of the great assembly
stages.description: Fruit of praise.

stages.name: gate of the dwelling (zhái mén)
stages.gloss: entering the lotus-store world
stages.description: Fruit of śamatha.

stages.name: gate of the chamber (wū mén)
stages.gloss: enjoying the flavours of the Dharma
stages.description: Fruit of vipaśyanā.

stages.name: gate of the garden of play (yuánlín yóuxìdì mén)
stages.gloss: going out to teach
stages.description: Manifesting transformation bodies in the garden of birth-and-death and forest of passions, by the power of the original vow.

stages.name: perfect awakening (anuttarā samyaksaṃbodhi)
stages.gloss: swift attainment
stages.description: By practising the five gates for self and others the bodhisattva swiftly attains perfect awakening.

notes: Bands are the interpretation layer; the gates of merit belong to the Pure Land after birth.

name: The nine grades of birth (Contemplation Sūtra 14–16)

stages.name: upper grade, upper birth
stages.gloss: three minds; precepts, Mahāyāna sūtras, six recollections
stages.description: Welcomed by Amitābha and the assembly; on birth at once sees the Buddha and awakens to the acceptance of non-arising.

stages.name: upper grade, middle birth
stages.gloss: understands the meaning of the Mahāyāna
stages.description: Lotus opens overnight; non-retrogression after seven days; acceptance of non-arising after one small kalpa.

stages.name: upper grade, lower birth
stages.gloss: believes cause and effect, arouses bodhicitta
stages.description: Lotus opens after a day and night; sees the Buddha clearly after three weeks; after three small kalpas enters the ground of joy.

stages.name: middle grade, upper birth
stages.gloss: keeps the five and eight precepts
stages.description: At once attains arhatship.

stages.name: middle grade, middle birth
stages.gloss: keeps precepts for a day and night
stages.description: Becomes a stream-enterer; an arhat after half a kalpa.

stages.name: middle grade, lower birth
stages.gloss: filial and kind worldly person
stages.description: Meets the two bodhisattvas after seven days, becomes a stream-enterer; an arhat after a small kalpa.

stages.name: lower grade, upper birth
stages.gloss: evil-doer who does not slander the Mahāyāna; calls the name once at death
stages.description: Lotus opens after forty-nine days; after ten small kalpas enters the first ground.

stages.name: lower grade, middle birth
stages.gloss: precept-breaker; hears of the Buddha's virtues at death
stages.description: Hell-fires become a cool wind; lotus opens after six kalpas; arouses the aspiration for awakening.

stages.name: lower grade, lower birth
stages.gloss: five offences and ten evils; ten recitations at death
stages.description: Lotus opens after twelve great kalpas; the two bodhisattvas teach the real mark; arouses the aspiration for awakening.

notes: Grades read locally in T365. Bands are assigned by the practitioner's conduct in this life (upper: Mahāyāna practice; middle: precepts; lower: evil-doers saved at death); for Shandao all nine are ordinary beings.

name: From hearing the name to buddhahood (Larger Sūtra)

stages.name: hearing the name and rejoicing, even one thought
stages.description: Gains the great benefit.

stages.name: aspiration, recollection, merit (the three grades)
stages.description: Arousing bodhicitta, recollecting Amitāyus, doing good according to capacity.

stages.name: welcome at death
stages.description: Amitābha appears with the assembly (19th vow).

stages.name: birth by transformation; the rightly established group
stages.description: Necessary attainment of nirvāṇa (11th vow); non-retrogression.

stages.name: one life from buddhahood
stages.description: Bodhisattvas there reach the stage of one-life replacement (22nd vow).

stages.name: buddhahood / nirvāṇa
stages.description: Extinction (miedu) reached necessarily.

stages.name: returning to save beings
stages.description: Those who by their own vow choose to teach in other lands, practising Samantabhadra's virtue.

name: Jōdo-shū: settled mind, practice undertaken, manner of practice

stages.name: anjin (settled mind)
stages.gloss: the three minds
stages.description: Sincere, deep and dedicating mind; the conviction of birth.

stages.name: kigyō (practice undertaken)
stages.gloss: the five right practices
stages.description: Chiefly calling the name, the rightly determined act.

stages.name: sagyō (manner of practice)
stages.gloss: the four modes
stages.description: Reverent, exclusive, uninterrupted, lifelong.

stages.name: right mindfulness and welcome at death (rinjū shōnen, raigō)
stages.description: Amida and the holy ones come to welcome.

stages.name: birth in the Pure Land
stages.description: Non-retrogression; seeing the Buddha.

notes: The triad comes from Shandao's question 'how to settle the mind, undertake practice and carry it out' (T1980 438c01-02, read locally); the later stages are the general Pure Land sequence.

name: Shinran: hearing, shinjin, the truly settled, birth-as-nirvāṇa, return

stages.name: hearing the name and the vow (monpō)
stages.description: Hearing the origin and fulfilment of the vow without doubt.

stages.name: one thought-moment of shinjin
stages.gloss: entering the truly settled (shōjōju)
stages.description: Embraced, never to be abandoned; crosswise transcendence.

stages.name: life of the nenbutsu in gratitude
stages.gloss: 'equal to the Tathāgatas', 'the same as Maitreya'
stages.description: Still a foolish being full of passions; the ten benefits in the present life.

stages.name: birth in the true land = great nirvāṇa
stages.description: Necessary attainment of nirvāṇa (11th vow).

stages.name: returning aspect (gensō)
stages.description: Returning to the forest of passions to save beings.

notes: Band B5 for shinjin is interpretive: Shinshū itself speaks of entering the stage of the truly settled, not of 'seeing'; it would object to equating shinjin with a meditative insight.

name: Shinran's turning through the three vows

stages.name: the nineteenth vow: various goods, welcome at death
stages.gloss: the provisional gate of myriad practices
stages.description: Self-power practice of meditative and non-meditative good leading to the transformed land.

stages.name: the twentieth vow: self-power nenbutsu
stages.gloss: the true gate
stages.description: Saying the name while relying on one's own merit.

stages.name: the eighteenth vow: other-power shinjin
stages.gloss: the ocean of the selected vow
stages.description: Entrusting to the primal vow; birth in the true land.

name: Ouyi's three provisions: faith, vow, holding the name

stages.name: faith (xin)
stages.gloss: believing self, other, cause, effect, phenomena, principle

stages.name: vow (yuan)
stages.gloss: loathing Sahā, delighting in Bliss

stages.name: undistracted single mind in phenomena (shi yixin)
undistracted single mind in principle (li yixin)
birth, grade according to the depth of holding the name

notes: Stages 4–5 combine Ouyi with Zhuhong's two kinds of single mind (recalled).
